about: Pin and full screen follow a blip (D02.3, 2026-11-13). When the pinned or full-screen tile leaves the call the app holds {participant, kind, until = now + graceMs} (graceMs = the leave-chime grace); carryTarget(held, tiles, now) = the id of the first tile of the same participant (the LiveKit identity, device included) and kind (absent = video) while now < until, else null; the app then pins / full-screens that tile again. Byte-identical: desktop crates/app/src/testvectors/tilecarry.json (the owner; tilecarry.rs), web src/features/calls/testvectors/tilecarry.json (tilecarry.ts).

cases.name: the pinned share comes back with a new track inside the grace: carried
after the grace: not carried (a real leave)
the same person's camera is not their share
another device of the same person is another participant
a pinned camera comes back (the avatar first, then the camera): only the camera
a pinned camera comes back: carried
no kind on a tile (an older tile shape) reads as video
